Describe the protocol of an MFO test

Source: R/MFO_protocol.R
MFO_protocol.Rd

Builds an `MFO_protocol` object that tells [MFO()] and [MFOs()] how the test was run: how long each step lasts, which final segment of each step is averaged, how the load was prescribed and the exercise mode. The object only describes the test; it holds no data. Passing it as `protocol` replaces `step_duration` and `steady_state_duration` (SPEC 14).

Usage

MFO_protocol(
  type = c("step", "step_variable", "relative", "ramp", "single_day"),
  step_duration = 180,
  steady_state_duration = 60,
  load_start = NULL,
  load_increment = NULL,
  load_unit = c("W", "km/h", "W/kg"),
  mode = c("cycling", "running", "walking"),
  ramp_window = 30,
  ramp_step = ramp_window,
  cut_time = NULL
)

Arguments

type

protocol type:

  • `"step"` (default): steps of fixed duration, e.g. 3 min with 35-W increments (Achten et al. 2002, doi:10.1097/00005768-200201000-00015 ).

  • `"step_variable"`: steps of different duration, e.g. a longer first step on a treadmill (Amaro-Gahete et al. 2019, doi:10.3389/fphys.2019.00909 ). `step_duration` is a vector; if the data go on after its last element, that last duration is repeated, so `c(300, 180)` means a 5-min first step followed by 3-min steps.

  • `"relative"`: fixed-duration steps whose load is prescribed relative to body mass (W/kg), as in the relative power FATmax test of postmenopausal females (2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13315815/). Steps are cut as in `"step"`; the load unit is `"W/kg"`.

  • `"ramp"`: continuous load increase (e.g. 10-15 W/min) with no steps (ramp vs. graded protocols in postmenopausal women, Physiologia 2025, 5(1):3, doi:10.3390/physiologia5010003 ). Each point of the curve is the mean of `ramp_window` s; windows start every `ramp_step` s (default: back to back, no overlap). `step_duration` and `steady_state_duration` are not used, `method = "MV"` is not available and `min_steps` counts non-overlapping windows. With overlapping windows the points are not independent: R² and the SIN standard errors are optimistic.

  • `"single_day"`: the MFO test followed, after a short pause, by the maximal test in the same recording (Sports Med Health Sci 2026, 8(3):327-334, doi:10.1016/j.smhs.2025.02.004 ). Steps are cut as in `"step"` up to `cut_time`; the records after it are the graded test, used for VO2max when `db_graded` and `VO2max` are not given. Automatic detection of the phases belongs to the importers (SPEC 16).

step_duration

duration of each step in seconds (default 180). A single number for `"step"` and `"relative"`; a vector for `"step_variable"`.

steady_state_duration

final segment of each step that is averaged, in seconds (default 60). A single number, or for `"step_variable"` a vector of the same length as `step_duration` (its last element is repeated with the last duration). It cannot be longer than its step.

load_start, load_increment

optional load of the first step and increment per step, in `load_unit`. Used only when the test data have no `Load` column. For `"ramp"`, `load_start` is the load at time 0 and `load_increment` the increase per minute; each window takes the load at its midpoint.

load_unit

unit of the load: `"W"` (default), `"km/h"` or `"W/kg"` (always `"W/kg"` for `type = "relative"`).

mode

exercise mode: `"cycling"` (default), `"running"` or `"walking"`. Fat oxidation kinetics differ between modes (Cheneviere et al. 2010); the mode is reported with the results.

ramp_window, ramp_step

for `"ramp"`: length of each averaging window and time between window starts, in seconds (defaults 30 and `ramp_window`).

cut_time

for `"single_day"`: time from the start of the recording (s) at which the MFO test ends and the graded test begins.

Value

An object of class `MFO_protocol`: a list with the arguments above.

See also

[MFO()], [MFOs()]

Examples

# Classic protocol: 3-min steps, last minute averaged
MFO_protocol()
#> <MFO_protocol> step 
#>   steps:        180 s 
#>   averaged:    last 60 s of each step
#>   load unit:    W 
#>   mode:         cycling 

# Treadmill test with a 5-min first step and 3-min steps after it
MFO_protocol("step_variable", step_duration = c(300, 180), mode = "walking")
#> <MFO_protocol> step_variable 
#>   steps:        300, 180 s (last one repeated) 
#>   averaged:    last 60 s of each step
#>   load unit:    W 
#>   mode:         walking 

# Relative power test: 4-min steps of 0.15 W/kg from 0.45 W/kg
MFO_protocol("relative", step_duration = 240,
             load_start = 0.45, load_increment = 0.15)
#> <MFO_protocol> relative 
#>   steps:        240 s 
#>   averaged:    last 60 s of each step
#>   load:         0.45 + 0.15 W/kg per step 
#>   mode:         cycling 

# Ramp of 15 W/min from 20 W, 30-s windows
MFO_protocol("ramp", load_start = 20, load_increment = 15)
#> <MFO_protocol> ramp 
#>   windows:      30 s, one every 30 s
#>   load:         20 + 15 W per min 
#>   mode:         cycling 

# MFO test and maximal test in one recording; the MFO part lasts 24 min
MFO_protocol("single_day", cut_time = 24 * 60)
#> <MFO_protocol> single_day 
#>   steps:        180 s 
#>   averaged:    last 60 s of each step
#>   MFO test:     first 1440 s; graded test after
#>   load unit:    W 
#>   mode:         cycling
